summary: scripts/st-test runs every check with one fixed PATH (~/.local/bin, the system and nix profile directories, /usr/bin, /bin and nix's own directory) instead of the caller's, so seats with different PATHs share a pool tree's warm build instead of rebuilding the workspace; ST_EVIDENCE_PATH=keep restores the caller's PATH.
